'''Little Talhovi''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Little Talhovi system/Legends|Little Talhovi system]] of the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. A [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] connected it to the [[Talhovi system/Legends|Talhovi system]]. Little Talhovi was considered to be a promising [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]]<ref name="TEA" /> by [[43 ABY]]<ref name="date">The main section of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which includes a description of Little Talhovi, ends with a mention of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]]'s journey across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the beginning of which is depicted in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''. The events of that novel are dated to [[43 ABY]] by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> and, like the rest of the Senex-Juvex worlds, was under the control of the region's [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] [[Ancient Houses]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Little Talhovi was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]] and which placed the world in grid square K-18.<ref name="TEA" />
